14.t: In the easy beetle setting (switch 2 is off), the beetle moves slowly until 400,000 points, and four beetles appear in each wave after 500,000 points. In the hard beetle setting (switch 2 is on), the beetle moves slowly until 300,000 points, and four beetles appear in each wave after 350,000 points. Millipede™

In the easy millipede head setting (switch 1 is off), millipede heads enter from the sides of the screen at timed intervals. In the hard millipede head setting (switch 1 is on), millipede heads enter from the sides of the screen faster than in the easy setting.
